title: Tofu Kaiseki Course in Elegant Japanese Broth
description: A delicate and refined Japanese dish made with silken tofu, kaiseki broth, and garnished with elegant and velvety ingredients.

ingredients.name: Silken Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm or firm tofu works best for this dish

ingredients.name: Kaiseki Broth
ingredients.notes: You can make your own kaiseki broth or use store-bought

ingredients.name: Velvety Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the mushrooms to enhance their velvety texture

ingredients.name: Elegant Wakame Seaweed
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of seaweed according to your preference

ingredients.name: Japanese Sesame Oil
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality sesame oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use gluten-free soy sauce if necessary

ingredients.name: Green Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the green onions for garnish

instructions: In a large pot, combine kaiseki broth, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Cut the silken tofu into bite-sized pieces and gently add to the broth. Cook for 5 minutes or until the tofu is heated through.
Add the thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms to the broth and continue to simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the wakame seaweed to the broth and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
To serve, place the tofu and broth into individual bowls and garnish with sesame seeds and thinly sliced green onions.
